description: Verifies the issuer's ML-DSA-65 countersignature over {h, ts[, owner]}. issuerPub MUST be pinned by you (null_prov_issuer once, then reuse): a proof must never carry its own trust anchor. If you omit it, this tool fetches the issuer key over the private lane and says so - weaker than a pinned copy.

issuerPub.description: the pinned ML-DSA issuer public key (base64)
